abort.single_instance_allowed: BMS AI Automation is already configured.

user.title: Set up BMS AI Automation
user.description: Adds AI-assisted room matching on top of BMS Integration. Requires BMS Integration to be set up separately - this component only reads from it, it doesn't add its own devices.

init.title: Configure Devices & Rooms sync
init.description: Optional settings for the `sync_devices` service, which matches Tuya rooms (as organized in the Smart Life app) to existing Home Assistant Areas.

data.anthropic_api_key: (Optional) Anthropic API key, used only as a fallback to resolve ambiguous room names. Leave empty to skip straight to manual confirmation for anything not matched deterministically.
data.similarity_threshold: Minimum name-similarity score (0-1) required to auto-assign a room without confirmation

unassigned_area.title: Confirm room for {device_name}
unassigned_area.description: BMS AI Automation added **{device_name}** (via BMS Integration) but couldn't confidently match its Tuya room ("{tuya_room}") to an existing Home Assistant Area. Click Fix to pick the correct Area.
